rules.title: Text Alternatives Serve The Same Purpose
rules.description: For images that have alternative text, judge whether the text serves the same purpose as the image in context (not just that it exists). Quote the alt text and describe the image region.
rules.evaluationPrompt: For images that have alternative text, judge whether the text serves the same purpose as the image in context (not just that it exists). Quote the alt text and describe the image region. Ground every point in an exact quote, a screenshot region or a browser measurement from the context. If the context does not show it, answer insufficient evidence.
rules.recommendationTemplate: Rewrite the alt text so it serves the same purpose as the image: {{observation}}

exceptions: Decorative images with empty alt are correct and out of scope.
Presence of alt text is measured by A11Y-002; this judges its quality only.

act.note: ACT rules test that an accessible name exists; whether it serves the purpose needs judgement.

rules.userImpact: People who use screen readers get a description that does not match what sighted visitors see.
